therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD20-targeted antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity combined with proteasome inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell depletion and protein degradation pathway disruption in lymphoma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with low-grade B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that relapsed after rituximab

results.dose_information: Ofatumumab 1000 mg IV on days 1, 8, 15, 22 of cycle 1, then 1000 mg IV on day 1 of maintenance; Bortezomib 1.6 mg/m2 IV

context.duration: treatment until progression, follow-up approximately 2 years
